title: A comprehensive review of current robot-based pollinators for crop pollination
core_idea: Review and categorize existing robot-based pollination technologies (air-jet, water-jet, linear actuator, ultrasonic wave, air-liquid spray), highlight their crop-specific limitations, and discuss integration of automated technologies (information technology, perception, detection, control, operation) to address labor shortages and guide future design and development.
tldr: A review that categorizes robot-based pollination methods, notes their crop-specific limits, and advocates integrating automation and sensing to advance sustainable greenhouse pollination.
